learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn the magic words 'a', 'an', and 'the' to point out special or general things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use 'A' and 'An' when talking about any one general thing. Use 'An' before words starting with a vowel sound (An apple). Use 'A' before consonant sounds (A car)!
We use 'The' when we talk about a very specific or special thing, or something we already mentioned. Example: I saw a dog. THE dog was very cute!
Sometimes, we do not need an article at all! We never use 'a', 'an', or 'the' before proper names like 'Ravi' or countries like 'India'.

fun_activity.title: 🅰️ The Vowel Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your room. Say aloud 'A' or 'An' before five things you see! For example: An umbrella, A book, A pillow.

quick_recap: ⭐ 'A' and 'An' are used for single, general items.
⭐ 'The' is the boss article used for special, specific, or unique things like 'The Sun'.
⭐ We drop the articles completely before names of people and places.
